description: Screenshot of a messaging-app group chat titled 'Palpatine's Revenge', with green diamond avatars and pseudonymous participants (Dooku, Severus, Huck, Roger, Juules) timestamped May 17, 2:31-3:15 pm. The messages discuss 'RR', an expected Mueller appointment, drafting memos, media contacts and code names such as Limey, MF, AEWP, Camp Eagle and RM, reading as officials coordinating leaks. Circulated as a purported leaked chat among senior DOJ/FBI figures around the May 2017 Mueller appointment; its authenticity is unverified and the participants are pseudonymous. Filename S_comms.jpg frames it as 'comms'.
text: Palpatine's Revenge. Dooku joined the group. Dooku. May 17 at 2:31 pm. RR isn't taking shit.. and he knows our friends have stuff on him. Dooku. May 17 at 2:32 pm. I'm hearing Mueller, maybe by the end of the week. Severus. May 17 at 2:37 pm. Hearing that too.. WH will be blind-sided. Let's put MF back in the news? Can have S draw up memo on Turkey. With Erdogan thugs beating protesters in streets, it fits news cycle, and I'm sure we'll need a few more 'memos' down the road. Good practice. Huck. May 17 at 2:41 pm. I'm in. S, you in here? Our friends in NY still have secure connection set up waiting. Roger. May 17 at 2:42 pm. MF was mentioned in company group too... Evidently their work on the limey is paying off. Dooku. May 17 at 2:43 pm. Paying off how? Dooku. May 17 at 2:43 pm. Getting to him? Roger. May 17 at 2:45 pm. Yea.. he mentioned Limey in a call earlier this week. Scared shitless. Severus. May 17 at 2:45 pm. He isn't brightest bulb, but that project has worked perfectly. Roger. May 17 at 2:47 pm. It really has. Huck, didn't AEWP mention it when we gave him that tape? Huck. May 17 at 2:47 pm. Not AE, but someone else there. Not sure who. I wasn't listening in, but our carrier pigeon said in debrief that they said something along lines of: 'No wonder no one in our business has called Limey out, what's the point when you all keep bringing us great stuff? It actually helps our pageviews when she gets all of her minions fired up with dumb shit first'. Severus. May 17 at 2:53 pm. That's fuckin amazing. Juules. May 17 at 3:01 pm. Hey all, been watching in. Here with S in GT outpost. All go from us. Huck, will send memo to usual place. Do your magic. Juules. May 17 at 3:02 pm. Roger, any update on Camp Eagle? Roger. May 17 at 3:06 pm. Asset en route. Don't expect much from it. He's been out far too long. Juules. May 17 at 3:07 pm. Figures. Ok, Huck, keep that connection open and expect something to come through pipeline a little later. Just stall them. RM is happening tonight, so they'll have plenty to cover. Dooku. May 17 at 3:08 pm. Tonight. Fuck. Quicker than I thought. Huck. May 17 at 3:10 pm. Connection will remain open. Let me know if we want to tip on RM. Juules. May 17 at 3:12 pm. Just let it ride. Juules. May 17 at 3:15 pm. Today's time is up. Everyone knows what to do. Tomorrow will be busy day for all, so will let everyone know time when S hears from grapevine.
flags: Purported leaked group chat of unverified authenticity; likely fabricated or satirical
Participants use pseudonyms; real identities behind Dooku/Severus/Huck/Roger/Juules and abbreviations RR/MF/S/AEWP/RM are claimed by readers but not established
Mueller and Erdogan are only mentioned in the text, not pictured

description: Black-and-white meme poster headed 'AMERICAN COUP D'ETAT' beneath an inverted monochrome US flag. It arranges 27 labeled headshots of Obama-era officials, Clinton associates and Mueller/Russia-investigation figures in three rows, presenting them collectively as participants in a coup against Trump. Mueller's photo is captioned 'Dirty Mueller'; the woman labeled 'Susan Powers' appears to be Samantha Power, and 'Lorretta Lynch' is misspelled.
text: AMERICAN COUP D'ETAT. Barack Obama. Lorretta Lynch. James Comey. Hillary Clinton. John Podesta. Huma Abedin. Susan Rice. Aaron Zebley. Valerie Jarrett. Ben Rhodes. Sally Yates. John Brennan. James Clapper. Debbie WassermanSchultz. Evelyn Farkas. Susan Powers. Andrew Weissmann. Mary Jacoby. Rod Rosenstein. Dirty Mueller. Andrew McCabe. Peter Strzok. Lisa Page. Bruce Ohr. Nellie Ohr. Jeannie Rhee. James Baker.
flags: The coup d'etat framing is the meme's unverified claim, not an established fact
Photo labeled 'Susan Powers' appears to actually show Samantha Power
Labels misspell Loretta Lynch ('Lorretta') and caption Robert Mueller as 'Dirty Mueller'

description: Annotated screenshot of a verified Nancy Pelosi (@SpeakerPelosi) tweet from Sep 16, 2018 applauding Christine Blasey Ford and urging respect for her rights amid the Kavanaugh allegations. Red hand-style edits strike out 'Dr. Christine Blasey Ford', 'Judge Kavanaugh', 'Dr. Ford's' and '#PostponeTheVote' and substitute 'Tara Reade', 'Joe Biden', 'Reade's' and '#ChooseSomeoneElse'. The meme reworks the 2018 tweet to allege a double standard in Democrats' treatment of Tara Reade's assault allegation against Joe Biden (circulating spring 2020).
text: Nancy Pelosi @SpeakerPelosi. Tara Reade. I applaud the courage of Dr. Christine Blasey Ford to come forward to share her story. As we continue to learn more about these allegations against Judge Kavanaugh, we must ensure that Dr. Ford's rights to justice & privacy are respected. #PostponeTheVote. Biden. Joe. Reade's. #ChooseSomeoneElse. 6:50 PM · Sep 16, 2018 · Twitter Web App.
flags: Original 2018 Pelosi tweet is genuine, but the red substitutions are meme edits, not part of the tweet
The implied equivalence between the Ford and Reade allegations is the meme's claim

description: Screenshot of a tweet by Q Research Notables (@QAnonNotables) claiming YouTube CEO Susan Wojcicki said content contradicting the W.H.O. or not 'medically substantiated' (such as advising Vitamin C) will be removed from YouTube. Embedded is a still from CNN's Reliable Sources (April 2020) showing Wojcicki's interview, with a YouTube hand-washing video credited to Gordon Ramsay playing on screen and a chyron about hand-washing videos; a banner notes an upcoming Gov. Cuomo coronavirus update.
text: Q Research Notables @QAnonNotables. YouTube CEO Susan Wojcicki says anything that goes against the W.H.O. is a violation of YouTube policies. All content that isn't 'medically substantiated,' such as advising people take Vitamin C, will be removed by the platform. YouTube/Gordon Ramsay. SOON ON CNN NY GOV. CUOMO GIVES UPDATE ON CORONAVIRUS RESPONSE. @RELIABLESOURCES. NEWLY POPULAR ON YOUTUBE: HAND-WASHING VIDEOS. Susan Wojcicki | YouTube CEO. CNN. 11:51 AM ET. RELIABLE SOURCES.
flags: Tweet paraphrases Wojcicki's April 2020 CNN remarks; the wording is the tweet author's characterization, not a verbatim quote
Wojcicki herself is not clearly visible in this crop; identification rests on the chyron caption

description: First page of an April 29, 2020 letter on Rep. Adam B. Schiff's congressional letterhead to Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai and YouTube CEO Susan Wojcicki. Schiff thanks them for combating COVID-19 misinformation, commends YouTube's removal of medically unsubstantiated content contradicting WHO recommendations, cites 5G/anti-vaccine/bleach conspiracy videos, and urges YouTube to adopt Facebook-style notices connecting misinformed users with WHO resources. Page ends mid-sentence with a footnote citing a Recode article.
text: PERMANENT SELECT COMMITTEE ON INTELLIGENCE. CHAIRMAN. COMMITTEE ON APPROPRIATIONS. EX OFFICIO MEMBER. ADAM B. SCHIFF. MEMBER OF CONGRESS - 28TH DISTRICT, CALIFORNIA. 2269 RAYBURN HOUSE OFFICE BUILDING, WASHINGTON, DC 20515. 245 EAST OLIVE AVENUE, SUITE 200, BURBANK, CA 91502. @RepAdamSchiff · schiff.house.gov. April 29, 2020. Sundar Pichai. Chief Executive Officer. Alphabet Inc. 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway. Mountain View, CA 94043. Susan Wojcicki. Chief Executive Officer. YouTube, LLC. 901 Cherry Avenue. San Bruno, CA 94066. Dear Mr. Pichai and Ms. Wojcicki: As we all work to control the COVID-19 pandemic, I want to thank you for the actions you have taken to ensure Google's users are provided with timely, authoritative, and factual sources. I was encouraged to see your early commitment to working closely with other social media companies to jointly combat fraud and misinformation during this societal challenge that transcends any one platform or service. As we face this public health crisis, Americans want and need to receive the best information possible so that they can keep themselves, their families, and their communities healthy. I commend you for steps you have already taken to highlight information from official health sources and to remove or limit content that promotes harmful medical misinformation. YouTube's commitment to remove videos with information that is medically unsubstantiated or contradicts World Health Organization (WHO) recommendations is an important action to protect the health and safety of billions of users. The recently announced policy of adding links to fact-checking sources for certain searches is a further step towards directing users to accurate health information. Despite your best efforts, however, users will continue to see and engage with harmful medical content on your platforms, whether by intentionally seeking it out or otherwise. Among the harmful misinformation currently on YouTube, recent reporting has shown that it is easy to find videos spreading false and dangerous statements about the coronavirus or treatments, 1 including conspiracy theories linking the virus to 5G towers, anti-vaccine messages suggesting the virus was engineered, and videos suggesting that drinking or consuming bleach may cure the disease. Though the best protection is removing or downgrading harmful content before users engage with it, that is not always possible. As you are likely aware, Facebook recently announced plans to display messages to any users who have engaged with harmful coronavirus-related misinformation that has since been removed from the platform and connect them with resources from the World Health Organization. I urge you to adopt a similar practice for YouTube users and others who. 1 Rebecca Heilweil, 'How the 5G coronavirus conspiracy theory went from fringe to mainstream,' Recode, Vox Media, April 24, 2020.
orgs: House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence
flags: Only page one of the letter is shown; the text cuts off mid-sentence
